title: Merge Overlapping Intervals
prompt:
Implement `merge_intervals(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]` in `solution.py`.
Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return an array of non-overlapping intervals in ascending sorted order of start time.
Touching intervals like [1, 4] and [4, 5] overlap and must be merged to [1, 5].
